components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Vertically stacked sections that expand/collapse (FAQ, filters, settings groups).

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: Page-level layout with landmarks and responsive navigation for each profile's shell type.

components.name: AutoComplete
components.purpose: Text input that suggests options as the user types, from local or async sources. Single or multiple (chips) selection.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: Represent a user/entity with image, initials or icon. AvatarGroup overlaps several with "+N".

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Small count or status indicator, standalone or overlaid on another element (avatar, icon button).

components.name: BlockUI
components.purpose: Block interaction with a region (or full screen) during processing (POS payment).

components.name: BottomNav
components.purpose: Mobile tab bar with 3–5 primary destinations, fixed to the bottom of the viewport. Used through `AppShell bottomNav` below the mobile breakpoint.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Show location in hierarchy and navigate up.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Triggers an action. The most used control; sets the tone for every other control's API.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: Container grouping related content and actions on a surface.

components.name: Carousel
components.purpose: Cycle through items, showing N visible per page with responsive options.

components.name: CascadeSelect
components.purpose: Select a leaf from nested groups (Country → State → City) via cascading sub-panels.

components.name: Chart
components.purpose: In-house SVG charts (no Chart.js/D3): line, area, bar (vertical/horizontal, stacked/grouped), pie, doughnut, sparkline. Responsive via ResizeObserver; themed from `--ui-color-chart-*`.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Binary choice, or one option in a multi-choice group. Supports indeterminate.

components.name: Chip
components.purpose: Compact entity (person, filter) with optional image/icon and remove action.

components.name: Chips
components.purpose: Free-form multiple value entry (tags, emails). Values become removable chips.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.purpose: Pick a colour via saturation/value area, hue slider, optional alpha, hex input and preset swatches. `native` mode uses `<input type="color">`.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.purpose: Keyboard-first launcher (Ctrl/Cmd+K) that lets power users search and run commands or jump to pages from anywhere in the app. Combines a modal Dialog with a combobox input and a grouped listbox of results, supporting recent items and async (server) search with cancellation.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.purpose: Ask the user to confirm a consequential action. Promise-based API via provider.

components.name: ConfirmPopup
components.purpose: Lightweight confirmation anchored to the triggering element (row delete in a table).

components.name: ContextMenu
components.purpose: Menu opened on right-click / long-press / Shift+F10 / ContextMenu key on a target (table rows, tree nodes).

components.name: DataTable
components.purpose: Display, sort, filter, select and paginate tabular records. Flagship data component for admin/dashboard.

components.name: DataView
components.purpose: Display records as a list or responsive card grid with layout toggle, sorting and pagination. Primary catalogue view for ecommerce and POS.

components.name: DateFormat
components.purpose: Displays a date/time with `Intl.DateTimeFormat`, or as relative time ("3 days ago", "in 2 hours") with `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`, always wrapped in a semantic `<time dateTime>` element with the absolute value in a `title` tooltip. Locale comes from LocaleProvider; time zone defaults to the system zone.

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: Select a date, date range, multiple dates, month/year, and optionally time. Inline calendar mode for dashboards/booking. No date library: built on `utils/date.ts` + `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

components.name: DeferredContent
components.purpose: Mount children only when the placeholder scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver) — lazy heavy widgets/images.

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: Modal window for focused tasks that must be completed or dismissed before returning to the page.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: Separate content horizontally or vertically, optionally with a label ("or").

components.name: Dock
components.purpose: macOS-style launcher of icon items with magnification on hover (game launchers, desktop-like UIs).

components.name: Drawer
components.purpose: Panel sliding from a screen edge: detail view in admin, mini cart in ecommerce, mobile navigation.

components.name: Editor
components.purpose: Lightweight rich-text editor without third-party engines (no Quill/TipTap). contentEditable with an internal command layer (Selection/Range API) producing a sanitised HTML subset.

components.name: EmptyState
components.purpose: Explain why a view is empty and what to do next (no data, no results, first-run, error).

components.name: Field
components.purpose: Wraps any single form control with label, help text, error and required marker, wiring ids and ARIA automatically through context.

components.name: Fieldset
components.purpose: Group related controls with a legend; optionally collapsible.

components.name: FileUpload
components.purpose: Select or drop files, validate, preview and upload with progress. Upload transport is provided by the app (no HTTP client dependency).

components.name: FloatLabel
components.purpose: Bootstrap floating-label layout for InputText, InputTextarea, Select (native), Password. Saves vertical space in short forms (login, checkout).

components.name: FocusTrap
components.purpose: Keep keyboard focus within a container; restore focus on deactivate. `useFocusTrap(ref, { active, initialFocus, restoreFocus })` and `<FocusTrap>` component.

components.name: Galleria
components.purpose: Image gallery with main view, thumbnails, captions, indicators and fullscreen mode (product photos, media libraries).

components.name: Grid
components.purpose: Typed wrapper over the Bootstrap 5.3 row/column grid for responsive two-dimensional layouts: equal-width card grids (`columns` per breakpoint) or explicit column spans (`Grid.Col`), with gutter tokens.

components.name: IconField
components.purpose: Places an icon inside an input (start or end) without addon borders (search boxes).

components.name: Icon
components.purpose: Inline SVG icon from the built-in registry. Zero external icon dependency.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Responsive image with lazy loading, placeholder/fallback, aspect ratio box and optional preview (zoom dialog).

components.name: Inplace
components.purpose: Display value that turns into an editor on activation (inline editing of titles, table cells outside DataTable).

components.name: InputGroup
components.purpose: Combine controls, addons and buttons into one visual unit (`$` + amount + `.00`, search + button).

components.name: InputMask
components.purpose: Formatted input for fixed patterns (phone, postal code, serial). In-house mask engine (`utils/mask.ts`).

components.name: InputNumber
components.purpose: Numeric entry with locale formatting (decimal, currency, percent), min/max, step and optional stepper buttons.

components.name: InputOtp
components.purpose: One-time code entry split into N boxes; also used as POS PIN pad input.

components.name: InputText
components.purpose: Single-line text input with optional prefix/suffix adornments and clear button.

components.name: InputTextarea
components.purpose: Multi-line plain text with optional auto-resize and character counter.

components.name: Kbd
components.purpose: Displays a keyboard key or key combination (e.g. `Ctrl` + `K`) using semantic `<kbd>` markup. Resolves the platform-aware `Mod` key (⌘ on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere) so shortcut hints are correct for every user.

components.name: KeyFilter
components.purpose: Restrict characters typed/pasted into an input. Delivered as a hook `useKeyFilter(pattern)` returning input props and as `keyFilter` prop on InputText.

components.name: Knob
components.purpose: Circular SVG dial for a bounded value (volume, gauge input/display).

components.name: Link
components.purpose: A styled, router-agnostic anchor. Renders a real `<a href>` (so middle-click, copy link and open-in-new-tab work) and lets the app intercept plain left clicks through `onNavigate` to perform client-side routing with any router. Handles external-link safety and announcements, and sanitises `href` with `safeUrl`.

components.name: ListBox
components.purpose: Always-visible list for single or multiple selection with optional filter, groups and templates. Supports virtualisation for large lists.

components.name: LocaleProvider
components.purpose: Provide locale (BCP 47), direction and UI strings to all components. Defaults to `en` messages and `navigator.language` formatting.

components.name: MegaMenu
components.purpose: Large multi-column dropdown navigation (category trees, featured content).

components.name: Mention
components.purpose: Textarea that opens suggestions on trigger characters (`@user`, `#tag`).

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: List of actions or links, inline or as popup from a trigger. Defines the shared `MenuItem` model used by all menu components.

components.name: Menubar
components.purpose: Horizontal application/site menu with dropdown submenus; collapses to a toggle below a breakpoint.

components.name: Message
components.purpose: Inline contextual message: validation summary, info banners, warnings, errors.

components.name: Messages
components.purpose: Stack of dynamic inline Message items (e.g., server responses at top of a form), managed imperatively.

components.name: MeterGroup
components.purpose: Show multiple values as segments of one bar (storage usage by type) with legend.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.purpose: Choose multiple options from a popup list with checkboxes, filter and select-all.

components.name: MultiStateCheckbox
components.purpose: Cycle through N custom states (e.g. Public → Private → Shared) with icon per state.

components.name: NumberFormat
components.purpose: Displays a number formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat` (decimal, currency, percent, unit, compact notation) using the locale from LocaleProvider, with tabular numerals for aligned columns. Replaces ad-hoc `toFixed`/string concatenation.

components.name: OrderList
components.purpose: Reorder a list via buttons (top/up/down/bottom), keyboard or drag and drop.

components.name: OrganizationChart
components.purpose: Hierarchical top-down chart of nodes (org structure, decision trees), collapsible, selectable.

components.name: PageHeader
components.purpose: Consistent page title area: breadcrumb, title (h1), description, status tag, primary/secondary actions, optional tabs.

components.name: Paginator
components.purpose: Navigate pages of a data set; optional page-size selector and "x–y of z" report.

components.name: PanelMenu
components.purpose: Accordion-style hierarchical menu (settings navigation, sidebar sections).

components.name: Panel
components.purpose: Titled container with header actions and optional collapse — dashboard widgets, settings sections.

components.name: Password
components.purpose: Password input with show/hide toggle and optional strength meter + requirement checklist.

components.name: PickList
components.purpose: Move items between source and target lists (assign permissions, choose columns).

components.name: Popover
components.purpose: Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger with arbitrary content (filters, quick details).

components.name: Portal
components.purpose: Render children into `document.body` (or `container`) — SSR-safe; used by every overlay.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.purpose: Determinate or indeterminate progress (uploads, HUD health/XP in games).

components.name: RadioButton
components.purpose: Single choice among 2–5 visible options.

components.name: Rating
components.purpose: Star rating input or read-only display (supports half stars in read-only).

components.name: Scheduler
components.purpose: Read-oriented calendar that shows events in **month** and **week** views, with keyboard grid navigation consistent with DatePicker, a today button, previous/next navigation and event click handling. All date math is done with native `Date` + `Intl` (no external date library).

components.name: ScrollPanel
components.purpose: Scrollable region with themed thin scrollbars (CSS `scrollbar-color`/`scrollbar-width`, `::-webkit-scrollbar`), no JS scrollbars.

components.name: ScrollTop
components.purpose: Floating button to return to top after scrolling past a threshold (window or container).

components.name: SelectButton
components.purpose: Segmented control for 2–6 options (period 7d/30d/90d, POS categories, view toggles).

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Choose one option from a list. Two render modes: `native` (real `<select>`, best for mobile/POS/simple lists) and `custom` (popup listbox with filtering, grouping, templates).

components.name: SidebarNav
components.purpose: Primary vertical navigation with sections, nested groups, badges and collapsed icon-rail mode.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: Placeholder shapes while content loads, preserving layout.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: Select a value or range along a track. Custom-rendered (range needs two thumbs); single mode may use native `form-range`.

components.name: SpeedDial
components.purpose: Floating action button that expands into 2–6 related actions (linear, circle, semi-circle, quarter-circle layouts).

components.name: Spinner
components.purpose: Indeterminate loading indicator for short waits (< 2 s) or inline in buttons.

components.name: SplitButton
components.purpose: Default action plus a menu of related alternatives ("Save" + "Save as draft", "Save and close").

components.name: Splitter
components.purpose: Resizable panes (editor/preview, list/detail). Nested splitters supported.

components.name: Stack
components.purpose: One-dimensional flex layout primitive that spaces its children vertically or horizontally using spacing tokens, so app code stops hand-writing `d-flex gap-*` combinations and margin hacks.

components.name: StatCard
components.purpose: KPI tile: label, value, delta vs previous period, optional sparkline/icon.

components.name: Stepper
components.purpose: Guided multi-step process with step panels (onboarding, checkout, wizards). `Steps` is the navigation-only indicator.

components.name: Steps
components.purpose: Progress indicator for a multi-step process (navigation only; panels managed elsewhere, e.g. routed checkout).

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: On/off setting that takes effect immediately.

components.name: TabMenu
components.purpose: Route-level navigation styled as tabs (each tab is a URL). Use Tabs when panels are in-page.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Switch between related panels of content within the same context.

components.name: Tag
components.purpose: Label categorising or showing status ("Paid", "Draft", "Sale"). Always text, optional icon.

components.name: ThemeProvider
components.purpose: Root provider that applies theme (light/dark/system), app profile and density to the document, persists the user's theme choice and exposes `useTheme()`.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.purpose: Ready-made control for switching light/dark/system using `useTheme()`.

components.name: TieredMenu
components.purpose: Menu with nested flyout submenus.

components.name: Timeline
components.purpose: Chronological sequence of events (order status, activity feed, quests).

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Brief, non-blocking notification. Imperative API via provider.

components.name: ToggleButton
components.purpose: Button with pressed state (bold in toolbar, "Follow" button).

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: Group of controls with start / center / end slots (table actions, editor tools).

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: Short supplementary label on hover/focus. Never essential info (not shown on touch).

components.name: Topbar
components.purpose: Application header: menu toggle, brand, global search, actions (notifications, theme toggle, account menu).

components.name: TreeSelect
components.purpose: Select one or many nodes from a hierarchical tree in a popup (categories, org units).

components.name: TreeTable
components.purpose: Hierarchical rows with columns (file browser, budget breakdown). Shares column API, sorting and pagination with DataTable.

components.name: Tree
components.purpose: Hierarchical data with expand/collapse, selection (single, multiple, checkbox), filter, lazy loading of children, optional drag and drop.

components.name: TriStateCheckbox
components.purpose: Checkbox cycling `null` → `true` → `false` → `null` (filters: any / yes / no).

components.name: VirtualScroller
components.purpose: Render only visible items of very large lists/grids (fixed item size v1, variable v2). Used internally by ListBox, Select, DataTable.

profiles.name: admin
profiles.description: Back-office / internal tools. Dense, neutral, information first.

profiles.name: dashboard
profiles.description: Analytics and monitoring. Card grids, KPIs, charts; comfortable density, strong chart palette.

profiles.name: cms
profiles.description: Content management and authoring. Readable long-form, editorial serif headings, calm accent.

profiles.name: pos
profiles.description: Point of sale / kiosk. Touch-first, large targets, high contrast, minimal motion.

profiles.name: game
profiles.description: Games and playful apps. Dark-first, vivid accent, rounded shapes, expressive motion (respects reduced motion).

profiles.name: ecommerce
profiles.description: Storefronts and checkout. Product imagery first, strong call-to-action accent, trust signalling.

profiles.name: landing
profiles.description: Marketing and landing pages. Spacious, large type scale, hero sections.
